szoveg_eredeti:
SINGAPORE – Media OutReach Newswire – 26 October 2026 – BloodCounts! is the first healthcare project hosted by the Cambridge Centre for Advanced Research and Education in Singapore (CARES) in the centre's 13-year history, with local hospital partners National University Health System (NUHS) and SingHealth. The project will use advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to reveal new patterns from the complete blood count (CBC)* test and create opportunities for earlier disease detection in Singapore and worldwide.

The issuer is solely responsible for the content of this announcement.

By Cambridge Centre for Advanced Research and Education in Singapore (CARES)
